sources.entry: Textpattern - Flexible, elegant and easy-to-use CMS. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Textpattern is a free, open source, flexible content management system written in PHP that runs on a web server with MySQL.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Textpattern as a flexible, elegant, fast and easy-to-use CMS written in PHP. It is installed on a web server with PHP and MySQL. Releases are available as .zip, .tar.gz and .tar.xz archives from the Textpattern website or GitHub, and the .tar.gz or .tar.xz archives are recommended if you want its multi-site functionality. Install and upgrade steps are in README.txt and UPGRADE.txt rather than in this README. The README also covers development snapshots on GitHub, anticipated system requirement changes for Textpattern 5 (PHP, MySQL, Apache, Nginx), contributing docs, and suggested GitHub topic tags for plugins and themes.
use_cases: Building and running a website or blog with a CMS
Developing plugins or themes for Textpattern
Managing web content on a PHP and MySQL server
how_to_run: Check that your web server meets the system requirements (PHP and MySQL)
Download the current release (4.9.1) as .zip, .tar.gz or .tar.xz from the Textpattern website or GitHub
Follow README.txt in the archive for installation
See UPGRADE.txt for upgrading an existing installation
notable: Multi-site support, available in the .tar.gz and .tar.xz archives
Development snapshot available from the GitHub repository
Plugin and theme ecosystem tagged with GitHub topics such as textpattern-plugin and textpattern-theme
Targets Textpattern 5 as the next major release with updated system requirements
caveats: The README lists minimum and recommended system requirements that may change during development of the Textpattern 5 release
Installation and upgrade details are in separate files (README.txt, UPGRADE.txt), not in this README
